title: POC: Healthcare On‑Prem Inference SOW & Workshop Notes (draft)
content:
Context and objective:

This is a working SOW + workshop notes for a 6‑week proof‑of‑concept with HealthCo (regional healthcare provider) to validate Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) for clinical note summarization and secure embeddings for downstream analytics. Customer constraint: no cloud egress; KMS managed in their HSM; strict HITRUST/PHI controls required. Goal is to prove production readiness (latency <= 250ms p50 for short summaries, stable throughput of 150 qps for embeddings), integration with HealthCo EHR connectors, and establish a migration/price baseline for a 12‑month Dedicated/Private contract.

High‑level scope (what we will do in POC):
- Kickoff & architecture alignment workshop (remote + one onsite half‑day)
- Deliver a Private deployment of Redwood control plane into HealthCo VPC (customer‑managed network) with 2 inference nodes (NVIDIA A10x or equivalent) in sandbox segment
- Integrate with HealthCo KMS/HSM for key management (no persistent plaintext keys in Redwood)
- Deploy one curated model variant (quantized) for summarization and an embeddings model. Tune batching / KV cache profiles for target latency/throughput
- Wire up Redwood Console dashboards for token/cost breakdown, latency SLOs, and trace hooks for 5 instrumented endpoints
- Provide runbook + handover and a 2‑hour training session for HealthCo ML infra team

Out of scope for this POC (explicit):
- Full production rollout to multiple regions or heavy HA across three AZs
- Long‑term data retention changes or HIPAA certification paperwork (we can support but separate commercial engagement required)

Deliverables and acceptance criteria:
- Private deployment in HealthCo sandbox VPC with working control plane and two inference nodes (delivered). Acceptance: console reachable from customer jump host and sample inference calls succeed with PKI auth.
- Summarization endpoint: meets latency p50 <= 250ms for 256‑token outputs on 95% of test cases. Acceptance: run of provided evaluation harness (Jira SE‑3214) with pass/fail report.
- Embeddings endpoint: sustained 150 qps for 1 minute with avg latency <= 120ms. Acceptance: stress test logs and tracing.
- Security checklist completed: KMS integration, audit log forwarding to customer Splunk instance, network ACLs documented. Acceptance: checklist signed by customer security lead.
- Handover: runbook, rollback plan, and 2‑hour training session. Acceptance: training feedback form >= 4/5.

Timeline / milestones (6 weeks, target start 2025‑10‑13):
Week 0: Contract + access provisioning (HealthCo grants VPC access, KMS test key)
Week 1: Kickoff workshop (architecture, onboarding), base infra template deployed 
Week 2: Control plane + first node up, basic endpoint smoke tests
Week 3: Model onboarding & quantization profile, initial tuning (batching/KV caching)
Week 4: Security integrations (KMS, audit logs), console dashboards surfaced
Week 5: Performance tuning, stress tests, acceptance testing with customer harness
Week 6: Handover, onsite training session, retrospective and next‑steps commercial proposal

Workshop agenda (kickoff + onsite half‑day):
- 00:00–00:20: Introductions & objectives alignment (SE + security + infra + ML teams)
- 00:20–01:00: Network & KMS requirements deep dive (customer network diagram walkthrough)
- 01:00–01:30: Deployment topology options (single AZ private, dedicated pool sizing, fallback to hosted)
- 01:30–02:00: QA and instrumentation (tracing, SLOs, cost telemetry)
- 02:00–02:30: Acceptance criteria and test harness walkthrough (SE‑3214)
- 02:30–03:00: Next steps, action items and owners

Pricing sketch (POC and path to production):
- POC professional services (6 weeks): 200 engineering hours (SE + infra + security + solutions) 
  - Estimate: 200 hrs * $225/hr = $45,000 (flat PS fee for POC)
- Infra costs (customer pays cloud/on‑prem infra; Redwood management of control plane included during POC)
- Private deployment license (for 1 sandbox environment during POC): complimentary as part of POC; production license estimate below
- Path to production (12 month forecast):
  - Dedicated/Private platform fee: $120,000/year (includes control plane, console, alerts, basic SLAs)
  - Reserved inference capacity: pricing depends on committed vGPU hours; example: 2x A100 equivalent reserved pool = $75,000/month
  - Optional: 24/7 enterprise support + compliance bundle = $30,000/year
- Ballpark TCV if customer moves to Private with 2x inference nodes and support: ~$1.1M first year (includes committed capacity, license, and 3 months ramp PS)

Commercial and contractual notes:
- POC PS engaged under statement of work with standard Redwood PS T&Cs; HealthCo must provide SOC2/HIPAA attestation path info for production discussions.
- Data handling: During POC, logs with PHI will be stored only in customer‑managed storage, with audit log forwarding enabled. No model weights or customer data will be shared outside their VPC.

Assumptions (call these out explicitly):
- HealthCo will provide a test KMS key and a jump host with admin network access by day 3
- Customer will supply representative evaluation prompt set (min 500 samples) and an embeddings test corpus (min 100k vectors)
- Customer infra team will provide 2 staff availability for 3 half‑day sessions during the POC
- If hardware spec deviates (A10 -> older GPU), performance targets will be re‑negotiated

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: KMS/HSM integration delays. Mitigation: run a mocked KMS flow early and parallelize control plane network setup.
- Risk: On‑prem firewall/NAT restrictions prevent outbound metric forwarding. Mitigation: provide an agent option for push vs pull, and document customer firewall rules ahead of time.
- Risk: Model performance regressions after quantization. Mitigation: hold back a float32 variant as warm fallback and instrument automatic fallback policy in rollout config.

Resource plan (Redwood):
- Lead SE: Maya Chen (50% during POC)
- Infra Eng: Liam O'Connor (70% early setup)
- Security Integrator: Priya Nair (KMS & audit logs)
- Solutions QA: Diego Alvarez (test harness + acceptance)
- Optional: Staff engineer on performance tuning (ad‑hoc, 2 days)

Acceptance and handover checklist (short):
- All endpoints reachable and authenticated
- Performance tests pass per acceptance criteria
- KMS integration verified and keys not exported
- Audit logs streaming to customer Splunk (or agreed sink)
- Runbook and rollback plan uploaded to customer Confluence space
- Training session delivered and feedback captured

Open questions for customer (to clarify in kickoff):
- Confirm target SLA and latency expectations for 99th percentile (we currently scoped p50)
- Confirm whether PHI will be present in logs forwarded during POC or must be redacted
- Confirm hardware available for sandbox (exact GPU type + driver versions)
- Who will be the customer sign‑off on security checklist? Provide name & contact.

Next steps (internal):
- Finalize SOW language and PS fee in legal (target sign by 2025‑10‑08)
- Set kickoff calendar invite and request network diagrams from HealthCo
- Create SE ticket board (Jira SE‑3214) and link acceptance harness
